item.title: Emboldened by hybrid car deal, Europe coalesces around tougher China stance

item.title: Spirit of Hong Kong Awards: veteran who keeps flame of Cantonese opera alive
item.description: Veteran Cantonese opera teacher Leung Sum-yee does not expect every child who enters her classroom to become a performer. If they leave knowing what good Cantonese opera sounds and looks like, she considers that worthwhile too. “My purpose was not to train stars or idols.
